recipes.title: Creamy Garlic Pasta
recipes.summary: A silky, rich pasta coated in a garlicky cream sauce with parmesan.
instructions: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente.
Sauté minced garlic in butter, add cream and simmer.
Stir in parmesan, then toss with pasta. Season to taste.

recipes.title: Tomato Basil Soup
recipes.summary: Comforting tomato soup with fresh basil and a hint of cream.
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add tomatoes, simmer and blend.
Finish with basil and cream. Season to taste.

recipes.title: Grilled Lemon Herb Chicken
recipes.summary: Juicy chicken marinated with lemon, herbs, and olive oil.
instructions: Marinate chicken with lemon juice, herbs, garlic, oil, salt and pepper.
Grill over medium-high heat until cooked through.
Rest and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Veggie Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Crisp vegetables stir-fried in a savory soy-ginger sauce.
instructions: Prep and slice vegetables.
Stir-fry in hot oil, add soy sauce, ginger, garlic.
Cook until tender-crisp; serve over rice.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast
recipes.summary: Toasted bread topped with creamy avocado and optional toppings.
instructions: Toast bread.
Mash avocado with lemon, salt, and pepper.
Spread on toast and top with chili flakes.

recipes.title: Beef Tacos
recipes.summary: Seasoned ground beef tacos with fresh toppings.
instructions: Cook beef with seasoning.
Warm tortillas.
Assemble tacos with toppings.

recipes.title: Berry Parfait
recipes.summary: Layers of yogurt, granola, and fresh berries.
instructions: Layer yogurt, granola, and berries in a glass.
Drizzle with honey and serve.

recipes.title: Shrimp Scampi
recipes.summary: Garlic butter shrimp with lemon over pasta.
instructions: Sauté garlic in butter.
Add shrimp and cook until pink.
Add lemon and parsley; serve over pasta.

recipes.title: Caprese Salad
recipes.summary: Fresh mozzarella, tomatoes, and basil drizzled with balsamic.
instructions: Slice mozzarella and tomatoes.
Layer with basil.
Drizzle with balsamic and olive oil; season with salt.
